critical_code_review_comments: backend/app/security/web.py - security_headers middleware correctly applies CSP default-src 'none' with no-store cache; verified live on /api/v1/* responses. Rate limiter is per-IP memory-backed (20/60s auth, 30/60s uploads) which is correct for single-pod demo but SECURITY.md should (and does) note this is in-process only; for production behind the k8s ingress a shared store is required - already noted in docs.

backend/app/security/sessions.py - server-side session table + refresh-rotation + revoke-on-logout is correctly enforced: old refresh returns 401 after rotation and access returns 401 after logout. idle=30min / absolute=12h parameters are documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
backend/app/security/login_guard.py - 5-fail-then-15min lockout works as advertised and is tested with a throwaway probe email so no real demo account is poisoned.

backend/app/services/upload_security.py - synchronous magic-byte + size + extension + zip-bomb guard rejects .exe/MZ at upload. XXE prevention is layered: upload accepts the file (status 202 queued) and parse_ckl/parse_nessus use defusedxml forbid_dtd=True so DOCTYPE/ENTITY payloads are rejected at parse time. This is defensible but DEPLOYMENT.md / SECURITY.md should state 'XXE is blocked at parse-time, not upload-time; the upload endpoint will record the file but the ingest run will fail-fast'.

backend/app/main.py /ready endpoint reports {ready:true, migration:'0009'} by consulting alembic current_revision; good deployment-gate signal. /metrics returns Prometheus text (aegis_http_request_duration_seconds histogram).

frontend/src/pages/Phase4Pages.tsx HistorySummary (lines 61-69) correctly maps diff_summary and counts into human-readable sentences and surfaces 'history preserved (0 observations rewritten)' when observations_rewritten==0 - the Part A content-history readability acceptance is met and visually verified on live preview with 6/3/11/2 and 15/90/21/2 counts.

docs: SECURITY.md explicitly disclaims FedRAMP/ATO/FIPS/CAC-PIV; EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.md and TEST_RESULTS.md honestly label Docker/OIDC-real-IdP/ClamAV/Vault/CI as 'not executed in this pod' - no over-claims found.
